title: Architecture
text:
Python + OpenAI Agents SDK + SQLite + real Codex workers. One local
            manager owner; no broker, workflow framework, distributed scheduler,
            automatic merge or deployment.
           
           Components 
           
             
               
                 Component 
                 Responsibility 
               
             
             
               
                 AgentBrain 
                 
                  Conversational agent owning objective, priorities and
                  mandatory criteria
                 
               
               
                 Supervisor 
                 
                  Serializes decisions while workers execute asynchronously
                 
               
               
                 Store ,  Control 
                 
                  SQLite goals, revisions, ownership, generations, messages and
                  policy
                 
               
               
                 Research ,  Knowledge 
                 
                  Discovery, hypotheses, evidence, evaluation and retrieval
                 
               
               
                 Implementations 
                 
                  Authorization, isolated changes, executable verification and
                  audit
                 
               
               
                 CodexRuntime 
                 
                  Native App Server sessions, steering, questions and
                  interruption
                 
               
               
                 CodexWorker  + Node bridge 
                 Original official SDK start/resume integration 
               
               
                 dashboard 
                 
                  HTTP dashboard with optional authenticated inbox controls
                 
               
             
           
           Context and control 
           
             SQLiteSession('manager:<goal-id>')  preserves
            conversation in the adjacent sessions DB. The latest 12 session
            items and task summaries bound prompt context. Original criteria,
            policy, decisions and knowledge remain retrievable; detailed worker
            histories stay separate. Role instructions live in
             instructions/  Markdown.
           
           
            A process lock prevents competing owners; an async actor lock
            serializes manager calls. SQLite inbox messages allow another CLI
            process to steer the owner. Waiting questions and external
            dependencies do not poll an LLM. Reasoning/time exhaustion records a
            pause.
           
           
            Permanent changes require explicit proposal acceptance. Policy
            versions and goal revisions are append-only; original mandatory
            criteria cannot disappear. Affected task generations reject late
            results. Unaffected work and old evidence remain. Policy/goal
            changes revoke implementation authorizations and approvals,
            requiring reauthorization.
           
           Research and knowledge 
           
             
               
                 Stage 
                 Contract 
               
             
             
               
                 Discovery 
                 
                  At most 20 explicit sources; map resources and rank
                  opportunities
                 
               
               
                 Focused research 
                 
                  At most 8 sources; one hypothesis, falsification condition and
                  budget
                 
               
               
                 Evaluation 
                 
                  Read captured evidence independently; support, reject, request
                  evidence or block
                 
               
               
                 Manager 
                 
                  Resolve the highest-value uncertainty; retry with feedback,
                  replan or stop
                 
               
             
           
           
            Research tools read scoped local UTF-8 files/exports only: 32 MiB
            per file, 1–100 lines per read. No shell, remote collectors or
            recursive crawl. Knowledge prefetch happens before investigation
            without consuming a discretionary read. DB-backed SDK tools are
            async to preserve SQLite thread ownership. Reports go directly to
            the manager.
           
           
            Captured evidence includes excerpt, lines, content hash, source
            modification time and observation time. Citation gates reject
            invented/stale citations and unsupported claims; LLM evaluation
            still cannot prove semantic truth. Only independently supported
            cited claims become verified. Rejected/invalidated findings remain
            searchable.
           
           
            Opportunity scores are
             impact * confidence / (risk * effort) , using explained
            ordinal inputs; unsupported confidence is zero. These are
            prioritization aids, not economic forecasts. Canonical
            question/scope/source/revision signatures detect exact repeat
            investigations, not all paraphrases. Changed/missing sources or
            observations older than 24h flag staleness. Metric freshness still
            needs judgment.
           
           
            Timeouts, tool/turn caps, attempt caps and a persisted goal budget
            (12 role runs by default, including evaluation) bound work. Three
            identical invalid plans escalate. Retrying requires targeted
            feedback and cannot reset budgets.
           
           Coding and verification 
           
             
              User authorization binds accepted research, current goal/policy
              revisions, allowed paths, checks and attempt limits. Every
              mandatory criterion needs a check; external oracles are hashed.
             
             
              Real Codex edits an isolated detached Git worktree with
              workspace-write sandbox and no sandbox network or automatic
              escalation. Candidate SHA, handoff, artifacts and concerns
              persist.
             
             
              Separate processes run authorized checks in a clean worktree at
              that exact SHA. Outputs, digests, exit codes and
              criterion/revision coverage persist. Source/HEAD changes fail
              verification.
             
             
              Local defects get bounded repair; incorrect assumptions return to
              research; repeated failures escalate. Success becomes
               ready_for_audit .
             
             
              A manager-requested audit checks current requirements,
              authorization, candidate and immutable artifacts. Only a passing
              audit completes implementation. No merge or deployment follows.
             
           
           
            Code goals can require verified implementation before any assignment
            exists. Test commands are trusted local processes with provider
            credentials removed, not a hostile-code sandbox. Oracle coverage
            bounds what success establishes; use external isolation for
            untrusted code.
           
           Codex and delivery 
           
             OPENAI_API_KEY  selects an explicit Responses provider
            through  env_key , never a persisted key value. Sessions
            use a writable local Codex home. Without the key, existing auth is
            preserved.
           
           
            Native methods:  initialize ,  thread/start ,
             thread/resume ,  thread/read ,
             turn/start ,  turn/steer ,
             turn/interrupt , and user-input responses. Persist
            thread IDs before turns. Steering uses native expected-turn
            preconditions, not fake conversation entries.
           
           
            Delivery states distinguish pending, sending, acknowledged,
            uncertain and  sent_no_ack . RPC acceptance does not
            prove task completion. Old connection-specific question IDs cannot
            be replayed after restart. SDK research uses cancellation and a
            fresh bounded attempt, not live steering.
           
           Recovery and observation 
           
            WAL SQLite retains ownership, progress, messages, evidence and
            revision fences. Native turns and journaled Git actions are
            reconciled before retry; a missing response does not prove failure.
            Progress counts distinct observations/command outcomes/artifacts,
            not tokens or repeated activity. Stalls pause work. See
             recovery .
           
           
            Dashboard snapshots use read-only/query-only transactions. Optional bearer-authenticated
            commands append to the durable inbox and are processed by the existing supervisor. The web server never
            takes ownership. It refreshes committed state every five seconds,
            shows bounded recent records, and retains the last snapshot on
            errors. HTML guides are maintained directly. See
             dashboard .

title: Mission control
text:
omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db dashboard
# Trusted remote access only:
omnitrix --db /absolute/path/state.db dashboard --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765
 
           
            Default: loopback, port 8765, read-only. Use trusted access
            or an authenticated proxy. Goals, paths, findings and messages may
            be sensitive. No API key is required. The manager runs separately.
           
           
             
               
                 View 
                 Contents 
               
             
             
               
                 Overview 
                 
                  Objective, criteria, latest decision, budgets and check totals
                 
               
               
                 Tasks 
                 
                  Search/filter assignments, outcomes and runtime/session
                  metadata
                 
               
               
                 Hierarchy 
                 
                  Manager and linked assignments; no invented child agents
                 
               
               
                 Knowledge 
                 
                  Findings, recorded classifications, citations and
                  opportunities
                 
               
               
                 Activity 
                 
                  Decisions, progress, questions, handoffs and delivery states
                 
               
               
                 Documentation 
                 
                  Searchable HTML guides, diagrams, tables and raw experiment
                  JSON
                 
               
             
           
           
            Click a record for details. Status is persisted state, not a
            process-liveness probe. Recorded knowledge classification does not
            guarantee freshness; revalidate before reuse. A passing check is not
            goal completion. Use CLI chat for steering and authorization.
           
           Authenticated control 
           Set  OMNITRIX_DASHBOARD_TOKEN  securely to 32+ random characters, then start: 
           omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db dashboard --allow-control \
  --allowed-origin https://jinit24.github.io
# Separate owner process; wait for UI commands without initial autonomous decisions:
omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db run GOAL_ID --steps 0 --hours 4 
           Choose  Connect manager , enter the backend URL and token, then use
           Manager chat . Supports messages, steering, pause/cancel, bounded decisions,
          reconciliation and policy/requirement proposals. Review and explicitly accept permanent changes.
          Code authorization remains in the CLI; no deployment or arbitrary database writes are exposed. 
           Commands enter the existing durable inbox. A queued receipt is not success: the manager replies
          and acknowledges separately. Stable request IDs prevent duplicate sends; stale revisions and
          cross-goal task references are rejected. If no owner is running, commands remain pending. 
           Enabled control protects state and commands with a bearer token. Browser tokens stay in memory;
          disconnect or close the tab to clear them. Cross-origin requests require an explicit allowed origin.
          GitHub Pages needs a reachable HTTPS backend (a trusted TLS proxy in front of this HTTP server).
          No public backend is provisioned by the static site. Localhost HTTP is supported for local use. 
           GitHub Pages 
           Pages shows recorded experiments until you connect an authenticated backend.
          Enable  Settings → Pages → GitHub Actions ; the Publish experiment snapshot
          workflow deploys on changes to main. Build locally with
           python scripts/build_pages.py . The export omits sessions, local paths and message bodies. No credentials or databases are published. 
           Data boundaries 
           
             
              Read-only/query-only SQLite transaction per request; no ownership,
              schema creation or writes.
             
             
              Five-second visible-page refresh; failures retain the last
              snapshot and timestamp.
             
             
              Missing DB stays absent. No fake/sample data or model calls.
             
             
              Latest 200 goals and 200 records per category per goal; use CLI
              export for full history.
             
             
              Read-only by default; opt-in authenticated commands, allowlisted assets, escaped content and
              local-only Content Security Policy.
             
           
           Rebuild HTML docs 
           pip install -e '.[docs]'
python scripts/build_docs.py
python scripts/build_docs.py --check
 
           
            HTML ships with the app and needs no external services. Only README
            remains Markdown. Edit the HTML guides directly; rebuild the bundled
            site after edits. Machine-consumed role instructions remain
            Markdown.  --check  detects generated-page drift.

title: Research campaigns
text:
Campaigns investigate a pinned local Git checkout using bounded discovery, hypothesis testing and fresh independent evaluation. They can remain active for days, with saved limits and an unexplored source catalog. The current Kafka investigation is an experiment; a multi-day reliability result has not been established. 
 Limits and money 
 The first invocation requires  --days  (up to 30),  --decisions ,  --research-runs  and  --dollars  (no greater than 25). Resume the same DB/goal without those flags. Saved deadline, consumed decisions, role attempts and dollar reservations do not reset. 
 The default manager strategy uses pinned  gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 . The optional investigator strategy uses  gpt-5.3-codex  for direct exploration, with GPT-4.1 independent evidence and completion reviews. All use the standard service tier and share one immutable dollar ceiling. Every request retains its actual model price, including after a strategy switch. 
 Model Input / million tokens Cached input Output GPT-4.1 $2 $0.50 $8 GPT-5.3-Codex $1.75 $0.175 $14 
 Rates checked 2026-10-19; review them if provider pricing changes. Provider input-token counting includes the exact inline request and tool/schema definitions. Requests above 200,000 counted input tokens are rejected; maximum output is 3,500 tokens. Maximum cost is reserved atomically before each paid request; actual usage releases unused reservations exactly once, including across competing settlement connections. 
 Automatic HTTP retries are disabled. A timeout, crash or lost response can have been billed: its full reservation stays held. The ledger may therefore stop below the cap. Fresh bounded recovery requests have their own reservations. Hosted tools, native Codex workers and unpriced models are excluded. Independent jobs using the same API account are outside this goal's ledger. 
 Large repositories and evidence 
 A streamed Git inventory builds a SQLite path catalog, with keyset pagination, component buckets and observed/unexamined counts. Full histories stay on disk; bounded manager state and recall tools prevent replaying the entire investigation. Excerpts and source counts describe observations, not exhaustive repository coverage. 
 omnitrix --db state.db campaign GOAL_ID --prepare-only \
  --evidence build/observations/context.txt \
  --evidence build/observations/service.log \
  --evidence build/observations/measurements.csv 
 Evidence paths must be existing UTF-8 files within the goal workspace, at most 32 MiB. Register exports explicitly; they retain a separate origin from tracked Git source. Record provenance, workload, units, measurement window, environment and limitations. Partition larger data. A local unit-test duration does not establish Kafka broker latency or production throughput. 
 Recovery and stopping 
 omnitrix --db state.db campaign GOAL_ID
omnitrix --db state.db campaign GOAL_ID --pause
# After diagnosing a deliberate pause or false early completion:
omnitrix --db state.db campaign GOAL_ID --continue-paused 
 # Optional direct investigation; the original deadline and $25 ceiling survive:
omnitrix --db state.db campaign GOAL_ID --strategy investigator --continue-paused 
 One owner holds the DB lock. Read-only SDK interruptions retain evidence and charged attempts; uncertain requests keep their cost reservations. Explicit continuation records the previous stop and resets only the stagnation window. Crashes and ordinary resumes preserve it. It does not authorize resetting limits or replaying native actions. 
 Deadline, decision, role-run and dollar exhaustion stop work. Eight decisions without a new source excerpt or revision pause the owner; rereading or recalling identical evidence does not count as progress. New workers get their bounded chance to read before the stagnation check. Invalid structured outputs and transient connection/timeout/429/500 failures allow at most three fresh planning attempts before pausing; failure counters survive restart. No action is replayed. Raw model output is retained in SQLite before schema parsing. Investigate persistent failures before continuing. The process needs a surviving host or an external process supervisor; no cloud scheduler or machine-to-machine recovery is included. 
 Default completion minima require 20 observed files, 4 component buckets, 6 independently resolved hypotheses and 2 verified code mechanism findings. A mechanism needs a workload and falsification condition. Evidence gaps and measurements have separate categories. These gates prevent trivial data-gap completion but do not prove correctness or prevent every semantic reviewer error. Do not invent issues to satisfy them; budget/deadline exhaustion may produce an honest incomplete or negative result. 
 After three discovery jobs, the manager allocation controller schedules a bounded test of an eligible cited mechanism/measurement lead before another map. Evidence-gap leads are excluded. The investigator selects and studies sources directly, then hands captured observations to a fresh independent reviewer. Each factual finding receives an explicit citation review. The hypothesis itself needs test evidence; missing support cannot falsify it. Absence claims require complete cited scope coverage, and literal absence proves only the exact query. One fresh reviewer correction may repair a rejected terminal review without rerunning the research. Genuine scientific insufficiency is retained. 
 The investigator also requires an independent assessment of the original objective and every indexed requirement against fresh verified finding IDs before completion. Unchanged failed assessments are cached. Numerical minima alone do not establish that the objective was solved. Controlled live comparisons still favour a single Codex-model agent on time and cost; see the  complete development comparison history . These reused synthetic workloads are regression tests, and the single-agent arm uses Responses API tools, not native Codex CLI. 
 Longitudinal tracking 
 research-quality.html  is generated from  docs/research-quality.json . Each issue has its original diagnosis, current status, and dated observations, changes, tests and regressions. Experiment summaries keep their earlier timestamped versions. Model outcomes remain separate from deterministic guard tests and manual validation. 
 Campaign HTML checkpoints are replaced atomically every minute and on exit. The SQLite history and exported report include decisions, research queries/evidence, evaluations, inventory queries, challenges, recovery events and a per-request spending ledger. Preserve the DB and any  .sessions.db  sidecar with their WAL state before moving machines; keep the pinned checkout and exported evidence. 
 Current experiment boundary 
 Kafka is pinned at  cc8baadc9f0363f2bdfe68a2f1cd8dbe4372d282 , with 7,545 indexed tracked text files and six explicitly registered local validation exports. The saved run has a 72-hour deadline, 1,000 decisions, 2,000 role runs and a $25 cap. It performs no external publication or source edits. 
 Live testing reproduced premature completion, repeated invalid plans and a false inference about JMH instrumentation. The prior accepted claim was challenged and downgraded; original reports remain. Navigation, controller instructions and completion checks have changed, but autonomous research quality remains under evaluation. A manually prepared Kafka LRU cache baseline passed three unit tests; that is environment validation, not an agent-discovered inefficiency or measured optimization.

title: Omnitrix exploration and exploitation: findings and repair log
Recovery & operations
text:
One manager owns each SQLite DB. Other processes may inspect state
            or queue commands.
           
           omnitrix run GOAL_ID --steps 50 --hours 4
omnitrix status GOAL_ID
omnitrix messages GOAL_ID
omnitrix send GOAL_ID 'What are you working on?' --id unique-id
 
           Preserve state 
           
            Back up the WAL-consistent DB, adjacent  .sessions.db ,
            instructions, Codex home, repositories/Git metadata, worktrees and
            artifacts together. Use SQLite backup or stop writes before copying.
            Copying only the main DB during WAL writes is unsafe. Preserve paths
            or repair linked worktrees after relocation. Credentials and
            processes must be reestablished; filesystem restoration does not
            restore them.
           
           Reconcile before retrying 
           
            Normal shutdown interrupts work and retains paused/uncertain state.
            SIGKILL cannot clean up. Restart marks running work and in-flight
            sends uncertain; budgets and evidence survive. Ownership uses an OS
            lock, not a stale PID.
           
           
             
               
                 Situation 
                 Action 
               
             
             
               
                 Unknown worker outcome 
                 
                   /reconcile TASK_ID ; inspect exact native
                  thread/turn
                 
               
               
                 Completed code, lost response 
                 Verify the retained candidate without coding again 
               
               
                 Known interrupted/failed turn 
                 Authorize a bounded repair after reconciliation 
               
               
                 Missing native history 
                 Inspect artifacts manually; do not blindly replace work 
               
               
                 Lost delivery acknowledgment 
                 
                   /resolve MESSAGE_ID delivered EVIDENCE  or
                   not_delivered EVIDENCE 
                 
               
               
                 Old question after reconnect 
                 
                  Resume with the actual answer; never reuse an old numeric RPC
                  ID
                 
               
             
           
           
            A missing response does not prove an action failed.
             not_delivered  permits a later explicit resend; it does
            not resend automatically. Native answers remain
             sent_no_ack . Exactly-once execution is not promised.
            SDK research restarts bounded attempts with prior knowledge; pause
            is interrupt/resume, not an OS freeze.
           
           Changes and stalls 
           
            Explicitly accepted policy/goal changes fence affected tasks and
            revoke code authorizations. Keep original mandatory criteria;
            reauthorize and verify current requirements. Unaffected work and
            historical evidence remain.
           
           
            Distinct observations, command/file outcomes and verification
            artifacts count as progress. Tokens, repeated identical events and
            process activity do not reset timers. Waiting does not poll models,
            but wall deadlines still apply. Research/repair budgets persist;
            exhaustion escalates. Inspect activity, messages, research
            runs/queries, external actions and audits.
           
           Nested sandbox limitation 
           
            Codex requires its real owner-only
             /tmp/codex-daemon-<uid>  directory. An outer
            sandbox may mask it with mode 000, preventing nested commands. Use
            the environment-approved route outside that outer sandbox while
            retaining Codex's own sandbox. Never disable sandboxing or weaken
            the reserved directory. Recorded live runs required that route.

title: Status & limitations
text:
Implemented 
           
             
               
                 Area 
                 Behavior 
               
             
             
               
                 Manager 
                 
                  Conversational Agents SDK session, durable
                  objective/criteria/policy and decisions
                 
               
               
                 Interaction 
                 
                  Nonblocking CLI, durable inbox, explicit instruction
                  acceptance, native Codex steering/questions
                 
               
               
                 Research 
                 
                  Bounded discovery → hypothesis → independent evaluation;
                  shared, revision-aware knowledge
                 
               
               
                 Implementation 
                 
                  Explicit authorization, isolated Codex worktrees, executable
                  checks, repairs and final audit
                 
               
               
                 Reliability 
                 
                  Restart reconciliation, stale-result fences, uncertain
                  delivery, progress deadlines, durable budgets
                 
               
               
                 UI 
                 
                  Status/tasks/hierarchy/knowledge/activity with optional authenticated inbox controls;
                  searchable local HTML docs
                 
               
             
           
           
            No deployment, automatic merge, broker or distributed scheduler.
           
           Evidence 
           Authenticated-control update:  89 tests passed, 1 live test skipped .
          Browser checks cover connection, message submission, explicit proposal acceptance and disconnection. 
           UI update:  60 tests passed, 1 live test skipped .
          Chromium checks passed for desktop/mobile layout, navigation, task filtering,
          details, docs search and disconnected-state retention. No browser errors. 
           
            Before the UI change:
             55 deterministic tests passed ;
             56 with opt-in live Codex . Tests use real SQLite,
            SDK sessions, Git worktrees, test subprocesses, process kills and
            cross-process messages with mocked model decisions. These are not
            live recovery rates.
           
           
             
               scripts/demo.py : accepted research → authorization →
              failed check → repair → audit.
             
             
               scripts/faults.py : nine fault scenarios, including
              stale results, misleading research, process termination, repeated
              failures and lost acknowledgments.
             
             
              Live: SDK start/resume, native commands, a manager reply in 2.52s
              during a delayed worker, policy delivery/interruption,
              conversation/message restoration and turn reconciliation.
             
             
              Live v2: manager completed 2/3 tasks and 4/6 criteria in 176.2s;
              single Codex completed 3/3 and 6/6 in 59.0s. No false completion
              claims.  No measured architecture advantage. 
             
           
           
             Experiments  separates fixture/model
            profiles and retained failures. No multi-hour run, statistical
            superiority, production benefit or new-machine restoration is
            claimed. Environment publication is separate.
           
           Known limits 
           
             
              Single owner, local filesystem, POSIX locks/process groups and
              source/editable install.
             
             
              Unknown native outcomes can require manual reconciliation; no
              exactly-once guarantee.
             
             
              Local bounded research exports only; no remote collectors or
              semantic duplicate detection.
             
             
              Citation integrity does not prove truth; content hashes do not
              prove metric freshness.
             
             
              Trusted executable oracles determine coverage; verification is not
              a hostile-code sandbox.
             
             
              Manager over-investigation can block useful work. The retry trial
              stopped over extra edge-case evidence; its explanation confused
              evaluator refusal with user authorization.
             
             
              Native APIs are version-sensitive; failed provider calls may omit
              usage.
             
             
              Dashboard is read-only by default, with opt-in bearer-authenticated inbox control, and bounded to recent
              state. Status is not liveness; recorded classifications are not
              live source revalidation.
             
           
           Next work 
           
            Reduce unnecessary research without weakening evidence gates. Then
            run repeated multi-hour paired trials with held-out oracles and
            equal-resolution telemetry. Add semantic retrieval, source adapters
            or infrastructure only when measurements justify them.
           
           API versions 
           
            Inspected:  openai-agents==0.24.0 ,
             @openai/codex-sdk==0.163.0 , Codex CLI 0.159.2 App
            Server schemas. Both Codex paths use  OPENAI_API_KEY ; no
            key value is persisted. Nested sandbox execution needs the approved
            route described in  recovery .

title: Experiments & results
text:
The manager has
             not outperformed a single Codex worker  in the
            recorded live trials. These are small trials, not statistical or
            production-wide evidence.
           
           Measured results 
           
             
               
                 Profile 
                 Arm 
                 Criteria 
                 Tasks 
                 Wall time 
                 Input / output tokens 
               
             
             
               
                 v2 · GPT-5.4 coordinator 
                 Single Codex 
                 6/6 
                 3/3 
                 59.0s 
                 232,753 / 4,404 
               
               
                 v2 · GPT-5.4 coordinator 
                 Manager 
                 4/6 
                 2/3 
                 176.2s 
                 461,690 / 12,328 
               
               
                 v1 · GPT-4.1 coordinator 
                 Single Codex 
                 6/6

                 62.6s 
                 266,871 / 4,364 
               
               
                 v1 · GPT-4.1 coordinator 
                 Manager 
                 3/6

                 112.4s 
                 287,409 / 9,309 
               
               
                 Scripted harness 
                 Single worker 
                 6/6 
                 3/3 
                 0.234s 
                 Unmeasured; no models 
               
               
                 Scripted harness 
                 Manager 
                 6/6 
                 3/3 
                 0.869s 
                 Unmeasured; no models 
               
             
           
           
            Live workers used GPT-5.3-Codex, medium reasoning. Each pair
            received the same initial source, executable criteria and 420s cap.
            Tasks covered deduplication complexity/order, bounded
            retries/permanent errors, and batching with duplicate/missing keys.
           
           
             v2:  Both arms could read the unchanged callback
            contracts in  system.md . Manager completed deduplication
            and batching through accepted research, authorized code, independent
            checks and audit. Retry stopped because evaluation demanded more
            edge-case evidence. No application exception, false completion claim
            or recorded human intervention occurred.
             Full v2 record .
           
           
             v1:  Manager completed deduplication; it paused
            retries and batching over callback contracts. No application
            exception, false completion claim or recorded intervention.
             Full v1 record .
           
           
            Unfinished tasks stay in denominators. Fixture/tool/model changes
            confound cross-profile comparisons. Token totals mix models and may
            include cached input; they are not dollar costs. Baseline internal
            research/corrections and comparative live recovery rates remain
            unknown. Failed diagnostic profiles are retained separately, never
            pooled into clean runs.
           
           
            Bugs found during live trials
           
           
            Fixed API-key routing, SDK/SQLite thread affinity, invalid-scope
            crashes, hidden read limits, unhandled manager turn exhaustion,
            prefetch budget starvation, missing report/check context, premature
            code-goal completion and mutable/unstarted-worktree scoring.
            Diagnostic trial 4 was partial after a scoring crash, not a
            fabricated zero. Trial 1 included a recorded policy intervention.
            Raw artifacts:  .omnitrix/live-api-trial-* .
           
           
            Separately, real interaction returned a manager reply in 2.52s
            during a delayed worker, then delivered policy steering/interruption
            and restored conversation/pending messages. That is a functional
            check, not a recovery-rate experiment.
           
           Reproduce harness checks 
           python scripts/demo.py --output .omnitrix/demo-new
python scripts/faults.py --output .omnitrix/faults-new
python scripts/benchmark.py --output .omnitrix/benchmark-new
 
           
            Mock decisions/coding use actual SQLite, Git and subprocess checks.
            The demo includes one failed complexity check followed by repair.
            Nine faults cover worker kill, manager SIGKILL, requirement
            change/stale result, repeated verification failure, misleading
            research, lost message/Git acknowledgment, external waiting, and
            activity without meaningful progress. Fault output includes
            JUnit/JSON and preserves pytest's exit status.
           
           
            The benchmark stores initial tree identities, exact candidates,
            criterion logs, goal/DB IDs, time, usage, repeated queries, repairs
            and completion checks. Missing measurements are null. Quality means
            declared criterion coverage; broader business utility is unmeasured.
           
           Multi-hour live comparison 
           
            Requires secure  OPENAI_API_KEY , writable sessions, Git,
            installed dependencies and an isolated development machine. Model
            calls are paid. This authorizes changes only in generated fixtures,
            never deployment, merge or push.
           
           export OMNITRIX_MODEL=gpt-4.1
python scripts/benchmark.py --live --allow-code-modifications \
  --hours 4 --steps 12 --arm-seconds 1200 --output .omnitrix/live-4h
 
           
             
              Use identical fixture/oracle, worker model/runtime and per-arm
              deadlines. Include all manager/research costs. Arm order
              alternates to reduce warm-up bias.
             
             
              Manager is model-driven; no mock plan. Authorization follows
              accepted research.
             
             
              Hours repeats whole trials and may overrun to finish the last one.
              Scoring is separate and uses immutable candidate revisions, never
              mutable worker files.
             
             
              Reuse completed arms; inspect incomplete native turns/journals
              before resuming. No blind replay.
             
             
              Keep steerable via
               omnitrix --db PATH status/send/messages ; record every
              intervention.
             
             
              Successful calls report usage; count native cumulative usage once
              per thread. Interrupted calls can omit it. Do not compare costs
              without checking completeness.
             
             
              An SDK turn ending is not a success claim. Compare explicit claims
              to executable criteria.
             
           
           
            No multi-hour experiment has been performed. Next: larger
            multi-service tasks, held-out oracles, randomized
            repeats/uncertainty intervals, equal-resolution baseline telemetry,
            and live interruption/requirement-change faults. Add infrastructure
            only after measured need.

title: Get started
text:
Omnitrix 
 A persistent engineering manager using the OpenAI Agents SDK, real Codex workers,
and SQLite. It plans bounded research, accepts steering during work, and verifies
explicitly authorized code changes. The manager has  not outperformed a single Codex
worker  in the recorded trials. 
 Install 
 Requires Python 3.11+, Node 20+, Git, and Codex CLI on PATH. Linux/macOS only. 
 python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e '.[test]'
npm ci
pytest -q
 
 Set  OPENAI_API_KEY  securely; all agents and Codex adapters use it. Never put keys in
goals, files, or the database. Model calls cost money. Without the key, Codex keeps its
existing login configuration.  OMNITRIX_CODEX_PATH  can select the installed CLI.

 constraint ,  add_requirements , and  affected_tasks ; omitted task IDs affect all active work.
Changes revoke implementation authorization. Pause interrupts; it is not an OS freeze.

 One manager owns each DB.  send  queues to that owner; it never starts another manager.
 resume GOAL_ID --steps 5 --message TEXT  restarts bounded work when no owner is running. 
 Authorize code changes 
 Accepted research and a committed Git workspace are required. Review  implementation.json : 
 {
  "objective": "Fix the bounded retry contract",
  "research_job": "ACCEPTED_RESEARCH_JOB_ID",
  "allowed_paths": ["src/retry.py"],
  "checks": [{
    "requirement": "EXACT CURRENT MANDATORY CRITERION TEXT",
    "argv": ["/absolute/path/python", "/absolute/path/trusted_check.py"],
    "timeout": 60,
    "failure_kind": "local"
  }],
  "max_attempts": 2,
  "seconds": 300
}
 
 omnitrix authorize GOAL_ID implementation.json --allow-code-modifications
omnitrix resume GOAL_ID --steps 5
 
 Every mandatory criterion needs an executable check.  failure_kind: "assumption" 
returns failures to research. External oracles are hashed;  OMNITRIX_CANDIDATE  identifies
the clean candidate worktree. Commands are trusted local processes, not a hostile-code
sandbox; provider credentials are removed. Authorization permits bounded worktree edits,
never deployments, destructive operations, merges or pushes. 
 GitHub Pages 
 Enable  Settings → Pages → GitHub Actions . The included workflow publishes three recorded real-model experiment runs and HTML docs.
Live manager state stays local; archived results are labeled as snapshots. 
 Research sources up to 32 MiB support bounded reads, search, and CSV aggregation.
Partition larger exports; observed coverage is not exhaustive system coverage. 
 Durable research campaigns 
 Create a fresh goal for a pinned local clone, then start a read-only investigation
with persistent time, decision, role-run and dollar limits: 
 omnitrix create 'Find system inefficiencies and compare falsifiable explanations' \
  --criterion 'Distinguish code mechanisms, measured impact and missing data' \
  --workspace /absolute/path/to/pinned-repository
omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db campaign GOAL_ID \
  --days 3 --decisions 1000 --research-runs 2000 --dollars 25
# After a process restart: reuse the same DB and goal, without new limits.
omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db campaign GOAL_ID
# Inspect or pause from another terminal.
omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db status GOAL_ID
omnitrix --db .omnitrix/state.db campaign GOAL_ID --pause
 
 Each campaign is capped at $25. Standard-tier GPT-4.1 requests reserve maximum
cost before inference; lost responses retain that reservation. Native workers,
hosted tools, code changes and external PRs are disabled for these campaigns.
An optional  --strategy investigator  uses a direct GPT-5.3-Codex investigator
with independent GPT-4.1 evidence and completion reviews. Both models share the
same saved dollar ceiling; switching strategy preserves all consumed limits.
The HTML checkpoint includes evidence, decisions, spending and remaining coverage.
Register local exported logs/CSV with repeatable  --evidence workspace/relative/path ;
record workload and measurement-window context alongside them. See the
 campaign and tracking guide  for pricing, recovery, explicit
continuation after a pause, and the limits of the current Kafka experiment.

 Research quality evaluation and self-audit 
 The  HTML findings and repair log  records baseline
failures, changes, actual live outcomes, and unresolved limitations. Its source is
 docs/research-quality.json ; per-goal HTML includes decisions, evidence, queries,
evaluations and measured model usage. Source/model text is escaped, never executed.
Each issue retains dated observations, fixes, tests and regressions. Latest run
summaries coexist with an append-only experiment history, including model costs
and coverage where available. A fixed guard is distinguished from improved live
research behavior; unresolved failures remain visible. 
 # Scripted tool/harness checks: these do not measure model reasoning.
python scripts/research_eval.py --harness-only --output .omnitrix/eval-harness-NEW
# Paid autonomous discovery: competing clues and a negative control, scored outside the workspace.
python scripts/research_eval.py --live --output .omnitrix/eval-live-NEW --log docs/research-quality.json
# Paid skeptical reviewer probes, including missing-measurement and partial-scope traps ($0.75 combined ceiling).
python scripts/review_eval.py --output .omnitrix/review-NEW
# Equal-budget controlled comparisons ($6 combined ceiling for two cases/four arms).
python scripts/research_compare.py --dollars .75 --output .omnitrix/compare-NEW --log docs/research-quality.json
# Real Omnitrix source, seeded failing probes, autonomous triage and authorized Codex repair.
python scripts/self_audit.py --allow-code-modifications --output .omnitrix/self-audit-NEW --log docs/research-quality.json
 
 Use new output directories.  --live  needs API credentials and API network access.
The self-audit clones the selected committed revision locally, retains every
candidate, and limits worker changes to  omnitrix/research.py ; independent oracles
live outside the candidate. It performs no merge, push or PR publication. Running
the script through an outer sandbox that masks Codex's daemon socket can block
worker shells; keep Codex's own sandbox enabled when using a supported execution route. 
 Synthetic scoring measures observable research behavior, with explicitly reported
lexical target matching. It is not proof of causal correctness or generalization
to large public repositories. The self-audit probes are human-authored known
failures: successful triage/repair is separate from autonomous issue discovery.
The research evaluator exits 0 only when every checkpoint passes, 1 for behavioral
failures (or no trials), and 2 for blocked/error runs. A completed agent conversation
does not by itself pass the evaluation.
